# Encrypted failure diagnostics

The owning workflow invokes this same-revision composite only after failure and a successful atomic age seal signals readiness. Each call supplies a literal plan or enabled platform slot. The uploader selects one exact ciphertext basename for the current attempt, with one-day retention, no hidden files and no overwrite. Plaintext, source files, keys and directories are never upload inputs.

The upstream action executes at a full immutable SHA. As with the kit's other composites, native locks retain its release provenance and numeric owner/repository identities without treating a workflow SHA as a mutable dependency declaration. Strict lock verification and the independent immutable-ref policy remain required. The inner failure condition permits the upload after the private step fails; the caller additionally requires the sealer readiness output.
